blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Cyprus, Slovakia and Slovenia formally joined the Association of Southeast Asian Nations’ (Asean) Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia (TAC) on Saturday ahead of the regional bloc’s summit in Manila. The three European countries signed their instruments of accession to the treaty, which promotes peaceful relations and cooperation among its parties, ahead of the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits from Nov. 15 to 17. Foreign Affairs Secretary Ma.
